records.interpretation_limit: The 2026 repository's cell-level metadata and code match its reported E6.5, E8.5, and IVC day-9 processed-cell counts, but the inspected PRJCA004049/CRA004601 inventory lists older PD_SC/PDCO_SC/E45_SC single-cell groups and E8.5 bulk RNA-Seq samples, with no D9-labeled scRNA-seq sample. The processed cell groups are not linked to raw BioSamples/runs or embryo IDs. This is a candidate data-availability mapping discrepancy, not proof of incorrect deposition, non-reuse, or data absence elsewhere; resolve the sample/run-to-cell-object crosswalk before reanalysis.

records.interpretation_limit: The accession's condition labels/counts and all-three-condition description do not directly match the Methods sentence describing three separate embryos for each of 40-MG and 40-MGT. meta_txt.interpretation_limit: These processed-cell counts match the article's reported post-QC cell totals and support group-level identification of the metadata file. They are cells, not independent embryos, and do not link the processed matrices to BioSample/Run accessions or recover embryo-level replication. The Results describe E6.5 scRNA-seq, while the scRNA library-generation Methods paragraph enumerates E8.5 and IVC day-9 samples but not E6.5; E6.5 source/reprocessing status is unresolved.

analysis_code_repository.gsa_archive_to_cell_object_crosswalk: not_established; CRA004601 run records map the older PD_SC/PDCO_SC/E45_SC aliases and E8.5 bulk samples, but no listed 2026 E8.5 scRNA-seq or D9 scRNA-seq BioSample/run links to the E8/E8L processed groups or code.Rmd matrix paths
analysis_code_repository.interpretation_limit: The article's customized scripts and group-labeled processed-cell metadata are public, and the three group cell counts match the article Results. The tracked repository snapshot omits inputs referenced by code.Rmd. Raw sequence availability does not by itself provide the sample/run-to-matrix crosswalk, embryo-level unit IDs, or the missing reference/object files needed to reproduce the presented analysis as written.

The 2026 Results describe E6.5/E8.5/D9 scRNA groups, while its library-generation Methods paragraph names E8.5 and D9 but omits the E6.5 source.

linked_2022_10x_dataset_crosswalk.interpretation_limit: The 2022 paper reports a group-, stage-, and platform-overlapping 10x dataset, and its natural-stage filtered-cell totals are numerically near but unequal to the 2026 processed totals. Count similarity cannot distinguish reuse with different filtering from separately generated or otherwise processed data. No shared barcode, cell, embryo, library, BioSample, or run crosswalk was found in inspected material. The 2022 data statement supplies no accession; the currently displayed PRJCA004049 scRNA BioSamples are described as day-2 Drop-seq and E4.5 Drop-seq. This does not establish that the 2022 10x data are absent from every public location, that the 2026 data were reused, or that the 2026 D9 group came from the PDCO/PD populations. No author contact or observations were made.
